formats.name: Migration Guide
formats.description: Gradual migration from one technology to another
formats.guide: Current state -> target state. Phased migration plan. Rollback strategy. Risk points.

formats.name: Tutorial / Build from Scratch
formats.description: Step-by-step guide that builds something from scratch with a working example
formats.guide: Step-by-step structure (Step 1, Step 2, ...). Every step contains a working code example. End with a "production readiness" checklist.

formats.name: Comparison / X vs Y
formats.description: Comparison of two or more technologies or approaches
formats.guide: Comparison table + deep analysis of each option. A clear "which one for which scenario" section.

formats.name: Patterns / Best Practices
formats.description: A collection of 3-7 patterns in one area
formats.guide: List 3-7 patterns. For each: problem, solution, working code, when to apply it, when not to apply it.

formats.name: Case Study / Optimization
formats.description: Deep technical analysis of one concrete case
formats.guide: One concrete case. Before/after metrics, decisions made, trade-offs.

formats.name: Mistakes / Pitfalls
formats.description: 3-5 common mistakes in one area and how to fix them
formats.guide: 3-5 common mistakes. For each: why it happens, how to detect it, how to fix it, a real-world example.

formats.name: Decision Guide / When to Use
formats.description: A decision framework for when to choose X
formats.guide: Decision matrix + criteria + alternatives. Summary in "If X -> Y" form.
